name: Minamoto no Sanetomo
bio: Poet of the Hyakunin Isshu (no. 93); Porter’s note gives the dates as: d. 1219.

poems.title: I love to watch the fishing-boats
poems.author: Minamoto no Sanetomo
poems.collection: A Hundred Verses from Old Japan (Hyakunin Isshu), poem 93
poems.text:
I love to watch the fishing-boats
Returning to the bay,
The crew, all straining at the oars,
And coiling ropes away;
For busy folk are they.
